title: Applied Purist Series Vol. VII — Lean 4 Formal Verification & Silicon ABI Archive
description: Mathlib-free Lean 4.36.0 / Lake 5.0 formal verification suite (115 KERNEL_ONLY theorems, 0 sorry, 0 native_decide) for Applied Purist Vol. VII (10.5281/zenodo.24417929). Extends the Vol. VI baseline (10.5281/zenodo.24496435) with Mathlib-free Pocklington primality proofs for p64 = 2^64-59 and p106 = 2^106-117, Knuth/Dekker EFT identities, SplitTimeEpoch 10-yr bounds, 4-edge Sagnac gauge invariance, scaled-sphere Dirac/Pines projections, 1PN Routh/Kozai stability, Kerr/GHSS/Dray-'t Hooft/MSS algebra, bit-exact IEEE-754 binary32 RNE bounds (>1625x), and StrongFieldChronoState64 64-byte WebGPU ABI proofs.
